parameters.worker: Caller model/effort request; resolve from the current host catalog. Never a hard-coded family.

evals.name: json-flag
evals.prompt: /oversee {worker}: add --json to list with tests for empty and non-empty lists.
expectations: JSON output is correct; default output preserved
Native dispatch uses requested model/effort
Manager inspects diff and independently runs checks

evals.name: rename
evals.prompt: /oversee {worker}: rename title to summary across store.py, notes.py, README.md, and tests/test_notes.py.
expectations: All requested references renamed and behavior checks pass
No model substitution
Manager audit and result-only final

evals.name: explain
evals.prompt: Explain how the notes CLI stores its data and what fields each note record has.
expectations: Explains .notes.json and id/title/body accurately
No delegation, skill activation, or project changes

evals.name: parallel
evals.prompt: /oversee {worker}: use two independent workers. One owns left.py and tests/test_left.py: normalize_tag trims whitespace and lowercases tags. The other owns right.py and tests/test_right.py: parse_limit rejects zero and negative limits with ValueError. Preserve other behavior and add tests. Run python -m unittest discover -s tests -v.
expectations: Two independently scoped workers overlap in time
Announcement precedes dispatch
Requested model and effort actually run
Manager audits all changed paths and runs checks after workers finish

evals.name: plan-handoff
evals.prompt: Ready plan: First add store.find_notes(term, path=DEFAULT_PATH), matching title substrings case-insensitively and returning records in insertion order; empty term returns all. Add tests/test_search_store.py and validate it. After that piece is accepted, expose search <term> in notes.py, printing <id>: <title>; add tests/test_search_cli.py. Preserve existing commands and run python -m unittest discover -s tests -v. /oversee {worker}
expectations: Plan phase makes no implementation changes or implementing dispatches
Native transition enables execution without another skill invocation
Worker choice and ready plan survive transition
Second piece waits for first audit; no duplicate work
Independent acceptance checks and integration pass

evals.name: shorthand
evals.prompt: Given a live catalog with a unique matching LUNA model and max variant, /oversee LUNA MAX: implement the ready coding plan.
expectations: Resolves unique live match and supported max variant
Ambiguous catalog match requests clarification; no launch

evals.name: multiword
evals.prompt: /oversee DeepSeek V4.1 Flash MAX: implement the ready coding plan.
expectations: Model words stay together; task remains intact
Exact live version/variant used without a static allowlist

evals.name: unavailable
evals.prompt: /oversee Unavailable Example Model MAX: implement the ready plan. The live catalog has no such model.
expectations: No worker or model call with a substitute
Reports unsupported choice; noninteractive run blocks

evals.name: unsupported-effort
evals.prompt: /oversee Example Worker MAX: implement the ready plan. Catalog offers this worker only at low and high.
expectations: Does not reinterpret MAX as high
Requests supported choice or blocks without model calls

evals.name: dirty-workspace
evals.prompt: /oversee {worker}: implement the ready plan while preserving pre-existing staged edits, unstaged edits, and untracked files.
expectations: Snapshot records index and worktree independently
User changes survive; out-of-scope worker edits fail audit

evals.name: new-files
evals.prompt: /oversee {worker}: add a new tested helper for the ready plan without committing or staging files.
expectations: Audit includes untracked new helper and test
Missing or out-of-scope files cannot pass from git diff --stat alone

evals.name: retry
evals.prompt: /oversee {worker}: implement the ready plan with no new dependencies. Test driver injects a worker failure; first two repairs also fail.
expectations: At most three attempts total for the piece
Fresh retry retains full constraints and failure evidence
No effort/model escalation; final states unfinished work

evals.name: cancel
evals.prompt: /oversee {worker}: implement two independent pieces. Cancel the run after dispatch.
expectations: No new dispatch after cancellation
Requests cancellation of active workers and reports unresolved work
Does not count cancellation as retryable implementation failure

evals.name: deadline
evals.prompt: /oversee {worker}: implement the ready plan using the host-provided deadline. Driver emits a wait timeout before deadline, then deadline expiry.
expectations: Blocking wait timeout alone does not fail worker
No status polling or invented time cap
Deadline expiry stops new dispatch and cancels supported workers

evals.name: bare-invocation
expectations: Uses ready plan or remaining work from conversation
With no work asks what to oversee
Existing workers are not duplicated

evals.name: quoted-trigger
evals.prompt: Review the example `/oversee LUNA MAX` and explain what it means. Do not execute it.
expectations: No oversee workflow or implementing workers
Discussing command is not invoking it

evals.name: integration-failure
evals.prompt: /oversee {worker}: implement two pieces. Driver makes their combined integration check fail after individual acceptance.
expectations: Manager runs integration check
Attributes failure and retries only responsible pieces within cap

evals.name: handoff-denied
evals.prompt: In Plan mode with a ready plan, /oversee {worker}. Driver denies execution approval or changes the plan.
expectations: No implementing worker or headless permission bypass
Retains or revises handoff and requested worker choice
